scripts.dev:browser: bun run assets && bun run --cwd ui start --configuration browser
scripts.dev:server: bun run assets && bun run --cwd ui start --configuration server
scripts.dev:desktop: bun run assets && bun run --cwd ui start --configuration desktop
scripts.test:ui: bun scripts/costs.ts run test:ui -- bun run --cwd ui test --watch=false
scripts.lint:ui: bun scripts/costs.ts run lint:ui -- bun run --cwd ui lint
scripts.build:app: cd desktop && bun ../scripts/costs.ts run build:app -- cargo tauri build
